summary: The documents related to MaintSuperAgency describe a web application for managing SuperAgency data, with functionalities for adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating agency records. The system supports data binding, user interface interactions like pop-ups, error handling, and form validations.
purpose: The purpose of the application is to manage SuperAgency records within a web environment, providing functionalities for data manipulation and user interaction.

workflows.name: Manage SuperAgency
steps: Page_Load: Setup page and initialize data if not postback.
cmdRefreshView_Click: Refresh and bind data to grid.
gridData_RowCommand: Handle commands for adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating rows.
uxDetail_ItemCommand: Save or cancel changes to details view.

business_rules: Only System Administrators can edit the screen.
If department or program dropdown is empty, the screen is view-only.
SuperAgency records should have mandatory fields like name and short name.
validations: ValidationSummary1 control for displaying validation messages.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable: Only editable if UserSession is admin and dropdown values are not empty.
Inactive: Determines visibility and availability of edit, delete, and reactivate buttons.
system_behavior: Bind data to grid on refresh.
Display error and warning messages using panels.
Show and hide modals for detail editing.
exceptions: No data found message if grid is empty in read-only mode.
Error handling through panels for displaying error messages.
